column1: # CIRISPersist FFI surface — the pinned classification.
# CIRISPersist#595 / CIRISConstitution#83. One row per symbol PyO3 exports:
# The class answers ONE question — "what different kind of wrong happens if I
# vary this?" — and NOTHING else. It is not derived from the name: a category
# justified by "these all start with `list_`" is not a category under #83, and
# this surface is prefixed by SUBSYSTEM (`cirisnode_`, `secrets_`, `tsdb_`),
# not by verb, so a prefix rule would have grouped `cirisnode_put_slashing_
# attestation` with `cirisnode_list_votes` and split it from `file_moderation`.
# It is pinned here, by hand, so that a class change is a visible one-line diff
# by a named author — the same shape as MINTED_NAMESPACE_FAMILIES (R2(a)),
#   structural   cannot vary — breaks the process, the handle, or dispatch
#   deontic      changes what the mesh permits; a wrong stub is a security finding
#   testimonial  makes the record unable to prove what happened (#83 twelfth row)
#   axiomatic    the cross-harness variable; changing it changes what two repos
# DESCRIPTIVE classes (revisable on this repo's authority):
#   ontological  changes who this node / key / identity IS
#   nomological  changes the model every other symbol reasons under
#   epistemic    changes how UNCERTAINTY is held — bands, absence, liveness
#   empirical    makes a checkable, RE-DERIVABLE world-fact wrong
#   axiotic      re-ranks outcomes without newly permitting any act
#   procedural   changes orchestration — when and by whom, not what is true
#   pragmatic    changes register or address, not content
#   contingent   out of scope by construction — EMPTY here, see README note below
# Two lines that are easy to get wrong, and the reason each is drawn where it is:
#   empirical vs testimonial — both are gate-checkable. The difference is
#     REPAIRABILITY. An empirical wrong is correctable by re-reading the world;
#     a testimonial wrong is not, because the record WAS the world for that fact.
#     `list_trace_summaries` projects the score plane and can be recomputed →
#     empirical. `audit_record_entry` is the only source of its fact → testimonial.
#   empirical vs deontic — a LISTING of permission state (list_trust_grants,
#     list_revocations, moderators_of_json) is empirical: checkable and
#     re-derivable. An ADJUDICATION whose answer a caller gates on
#     because misreading it permits what it refused.
# `contingent` is empty ON PURPOSE. It is defined relative to a comparison
# between arms of a variation study, and an FFI surface has no such arms. The
# thing it might have been stretched to cover — build-conditional presence via
# `#[cfg(feature = ...)]` — is an ORTHOGONAL axis the eleven do not have, and is
# DERIVED (see `pyi_surface.py report`), never pinned. 158 methods are
# build-conditional and a `.pyi` structurally cannot express that.
